findings.title: Broken Object-Level Authorization (BOLA) via Client-Controlled Headers/Query Params
findings.snippet: let userEmail = (req.headers['x-user-email'] || req.query.email || req.body?.email || '').trim().toLowerCase(); | let userCompany = (req.headers['x-user-company'] || req.query.company || req.body?.company || req.body?.companyName || '').trim();
findings.description: resolveCustomerContext() trusts unauthenticated client-supplied `x-user-email`, `x-user-company`, `query.email`, and `query.company` without requiring a valid Bearer token. Anyone can impersonate another tenant by spoofing headers.

findings.title: Missing Cryptographic Payment Signature Verification
findings.description: POST /api/payment/verify creates active subscriptions and invoices without verifying Razorpay HMAC SHA256 signature. Any client can forge payment success.

findings.title: File Attachments Stored as Raw Base64 in Database without Antivirus/Malware Inspection
findings.description: Attachments are received as base64 JSON payload and stored in PostgreSQL JSONB/disk without virus scanning or magic bytes content-type verification.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Ticket Attachment Access (IDOR)
findings.description: GET /api/tickets/attachments/:id has no authentication middleware or tenant ownership check. Anyone with an attachment ID can download private customer files.
